India's T20I reign ends after series loss to England

England defeated India by 56 runs in the final T20I match, completing a 4-0 series whitewash. This loss concluded India's 1,601-day reign as the world's number one ranked T20I team. England's strong batting performance, including a record partnership, set a high target that India could not reach despite individual half-centuries.
